class ComputedPrivate {private value=1;}
const privateKey="value";
const {[privateKey]: privateValue}=new ComputedPrivate();
const broadKey: string="value";
const {[broadKey]: broadValue}={value:1};
const missingUnionKey="value" as "value"|"missing";
const {[missingUnionKey]: missingUnionValue}={value:1};
const exactKey="value";
const {[exactKey]: wrongType}={value:1};
const stringCheck: string=wrongType;
const {[exactKey]: omitted, ...rest}={value:1,label:"kept"};
console.log(rest.value);
const possibleKeys="left" as "left"|"right";
const {[possibleKeys]: choice, ...choicesRest}={left:1,right:2,kept:3};
console.log(choicesRest.left);
